conversation.contentPreview:
Build a Todo app in a single self-contained HTML file. Requirements:
- Add new todos
- Mark todos as complete (strikethrough)
- Delete todos
- Filter: All / Active / Completed
- Persist to localStorage

Deliver only the HTML file with JS, CSS, HTML. Use file name "todo_openai-gpt-5.6-terra_01.html"

toolCallDetails.arguments: {"path":"todo_openai-gpt-5.6-terra_01.html","edit_description":"Create a single, self-contained, polished Todo app HTML file. Include all CSS and JavaScript inline, no external dependencies. Implement: an accessible input and Add button (form submit supported) to add non-empty todos; todo rows with checkbox toggles that apply a visible strikethrough completed state; individual delete buttons; All, Active, and Completed filter buttons with active state and appropriate empty-state messages; item count and a Clear completed button. Persist a JSON array of todo objects (id, text, completed) to localStorage and restore safely on load, gracefully handling malformed storage. Use event listeners and safe DOM APIs (textContent, not user HTML injection). Design a modern responsive card interface with clear focus styles and accessible labels. The requested filename must be the final deliverable."}
